data.title: Cadillac Mines Corporation Completes Acquisition of Larder Property from Pan American Silver
data.description: Cadillac Mines has recently completed the acquisition of Pan American Silver’s Larder Property, significantly expanding its gold resource base and Abitibi land position to over 27,000 hectares. This move marks a substantial growth for Cadillac Mines and underscores their commitment to expanding their presence in the mining sector.

data.description: A recent study revealed that the average global temperature has increased by 1.2 degrees Celsius since the pre-industrial era. This surpasses the target of limiting the temperature increase to 1.5 degrees Celsius as recommended by the Paris Agreement. The study also found that carbon dioxide levels have reached a record high of 415 parts per million in 2021. These alarming trends highlight the urgent need for countries to take immediate and significant actions to mitigate the effects of climate change.

data.title: AFL and Alcyon Photonics Collaborate to Advance Next-Generation Fiber to PIC Coupling for AI Infrastructure
data.description: A partnership has been revealed between AFL and Alcyon Photonics to create cutting-edge optical coupling solutions for advancing fiber-to-PIC coupling. AFL, a top manufacturer of fiber optic products, will collaborate with Alcyon Photonics, known for their expertise in photonic integrated IP and design. This initiative aims to enhance connectivity for AI and hyperscale data center applications, focusing on multi-core setups. The collaboration is anticipated to develop high-efficiency solutions for next-gen fiber optics and PIC coupling, bringing innovation to the industry.

data.title: Blackstone Mortgage Trust Declares $0.47 Per Share Dividend
data.description: In New York, Blackstone Mortgage Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BXMT) announced a dividend of $0.47 per share for class A common stock for the third quarter of 2026. The dividend will be paid out on October 15, 2026, to shareholders on record as of September 30, 2026. Blackstone Mortgage Trust (NYSE: BXMT) operates as a real estate finance company specializing in originating, acquiring, and overseeing senior loans and other debt investments.

data.title: Vivmark Residential Publishes Updated Investor Presentation and Provides Operating Update
data.description: A leading residential company, Vivmark Residential (NYSE: VMRK), recently released an investor presentation detailing its operations and developments. This release coincided with the company's involvement in the BofA Securities Global Real Estate Conference on September 16, 2026. Vivmark Residential came into existence as a result of a merger between AvalonBay Communities, Inc. (AVB) and Equity Residential (EQR) on August 17, 2026. Key highlights from the presentation include the establishment of full-year 2026 plans.

data.title: Camden Property Trust Announces Third Quarter 2026 Dividend
data.description: In Houston, the Board of Trust Managers of Camden Property Trust (NYSE:CPT) announced a cash dividend of $1.06 per share for the third quarter of 2026. This dividend is for holders of record as of September 30, 2026, and will be paid on October 16, 2026. Camden Property Trust, an S&P 500 Company, specializes in real estate activities including ownership, management, development, redevelopment, acquisition, and construction of multifamily apartments.

data.title: EPR Properties Declares Monthly Dividend for Common Shareholders and Quarterly Dividends for Preferred Shareholders
data.description: EPR Properties (NYSE: EPR) based in Kansas City, Missouri, announced the declaration of its monthly cash common dividend and quarterly preferred dividends. The dividends are set to be paid on October 15, 2026, to shareholders who are recorded as of September 30, 2026.

data.title: CareTrust REIT Announces Quarterly Dividend of $0.39 per Share

This dividend is set to be paid to common stockholders recorded by September 30, 2026. CareTrust REIT, Inc. plans to distribute this dividend around October 15, 2026. data.title: Charter Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend on Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock
data.description: In Stamford, Connecticut on September 15, 2026, Charter Communications, Inc. revealed that its Board of Directors has approved the regular quarterly cash dividend for holders of its Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. The Company's stock trades on NASDAQ under the tickers CHTR and CHTRP.

data.title: Identiv Completes Sale of IoT Assets and Renames Company INVE Technologies, Inc.
data.description: In a recent development, Identiv, Inc. has rebranded itself as INVE Technologies, Inc. The company is shifting its focus towards establishing a Physical AI Software as a Service (SaaS) business and anticipates bolstering this initiative through a strategic partnership with Trackonomy. Additionally, James Greenwell will take over as the interim CEO starting September 21, 2026. These changes come into effect from September 15, 2026, and mark a significant transformation for the company based in Santa Ana, California.

data.title: Attalon and AeroVironment Execute Long-Term Agreement Supporting Production of Mission-Ready High-Energy Laser Systems
data.description: Philadelphia-based AeroVironment has signed a long-term agreement (LTA) with Attalon for the delivery of Attalon's Valaris high-energy laser platform. The agreement aims to support AeroVironment's LOCUST® and other high-energy laser programs as interest in mission-ready directed energy capabilities increases. The partnership comes in response to the growing demand for deployable directed energy solutions. This collaboration will see the integration of Attalon's advanced laser technology into AeroVironment's product line, enhancing its portfolio of high-energy laser offerings.

data.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend
data.description: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLXS) based in DUBUQUE, Iowa, has reported that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend of $0.25 per share. The dividend will be payable on October 12, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. Notably, Flexsteel has continuously paid out cash dividends on its common stock every year since 1938, marking this upcoming dividend as the 339th consecutive quarterly cash dividend. The company, commonly referred to as Flexsteel, is recognized as one of the largest residential furniture manufacturers.

This dividend is slated to be paid out on October 30, 2026, to shareholders recorded on September 30, 2026. This move aims to benefit the holders of Danaher Corporation's common stock.

data.title: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Limited Receives Nasdaq Notice Regarding Minimum Bid Price Deficiency
data.description: Baosheng has been notified by Nasdaq regarding their stock's failure to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1 per share. They now have until March 9, 2027, to increase the stock price and regain compliance with Nasdaq regulations. Despite this notification, Baosheng's listing on the exchange will remain active during this period.

data.title: BKV Completes Acquisition of Barnett Shale Upstream, Midstream, and Carbon Capture Assets
data.description: In Denver, BKV Corporation (NYSE: BKV) has successfully finalized the purchase of specific Barnett Shale upstream, midstream, and CCS assets. The exact details of the deal remain undisclosed. This acquisition signifies a significant step forward for BKV as it enhances their closed-loop energy approach. By incorporating additional top-notch, low-decline Barnett Shale assets into their portfolio, BKV is intensifying its operational reach and boosting production capacity. These assets align well with the Company’s current operations and infrastructure, paving the way for further growth.
